overview_description.description:
Response is a Y Combinator-backed SaaS platform designed to help 3PLs, distributors, and retailers simplify and optimize indirect spend—everyday purchases like packaging, maintenance supplies, and office essentials. By providing real-time SKU-level visibility, automated purchase controls, and actionable insights, Response enables companies to reduce costs, eliminate rogue spend, and streamline procurement workflows.

Customers, including Warehouse Specialists Inc. (WSI) and Aterian (NASDAQ: ATER), have achieved up to 13.2% cost savings through vendor consolidation and up to 91.6% reduction in time spent ordering.

Our vision is to build the world’s first digital procurement officer for indirect spend, leveraging AI to take the busywork of ordering and the guesswork of vendor negotiations off our customers’ plates.

product.name: Response Procurement Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that centralizes and manages indirect spend by consolidating vendor orders, enforcing spend controls, and providing real-time visibility into procurement activities.

product.name: Purchase Order Management
product.description: A tool within the platform that manages purchase orders end-to-end, allowing users to create, track, and control POs across multiple vendors and locations.

product.name: Spend Control and Approval Workflows
product.description: Features that allow organizations to set spend limits, automate approval processes, and enforce compliance with purchasing policies to prevent unauthorized spending.

product.name: Personalized Storefronts
product.description: Customizable online storefronts that restrict product visibility and purchasing options based on department or location to ensure compliance with approved catalogs.

product.name: Analytics and Reporting
product.description: Tools that provide detailed spending data and insights at the SKU level to help organizations monitor procurement activities and identify savings opportunities.
